reference.wording: Original plain-language paraphrases; not copied standard text
reference.scope: Generic failure-mode meaning only. FMI does not identify the failed component or prove a repair.
reference.review_status: Reference paraphrase; confirm against the applicable licensed standard edition and OEM implementation before treating as authoritative.

entries.0: Measured value is valid but above the expected operating range at the most severe level.
entries.1: Measured value is valid but below the expected operating range at the most severe level.
entries.2: Signal data is unstable, intermittent, or otherwise implausible.
entries.3: Voltage is higher than expected or the circuit may be shorted to a supply.
entries.4: Voltage is lower than expected or the circuit may be shorted to ground.
entries.5: Circuit current is lower than expected; an open circuit or high resistance may be involved.
entries.6: Circuit current is higher than expected; an overload or short to ground may be involved.
entries.7: A mechanical system is not responding as expected or may be out of adjustment.
entries.8: Signal frequency, pulse width, or period is outside the expected range.
entries.9: Data is not being updated at the expected rate.
entries.10: The rate of change in the reported value is outside the expected range.
entries.11: The specific failure cannot be determined from this FMI alone.
entries.12: An intelligent device or component has reported an internal fault.
entries.13: The reported value or device is outside its calibration range.
entries.14: A special instruction or condition applies; consult the OEM definition.
entries.15: Measured value is valid but above the expected range at the least severe level.
entries.16: Measured value is valid but above the expected range at a moderately severe level.
entries.17: Measured value is valid but below the expected range at the least severe level.
entries.18: Measured value is valid but below the expected range at a moderately severe level.
entries.19: Received network data is in error.
entries.20: Reported value has drifted higher than expected.
entries.21: Reported value has drifted lower than expected.
entries.31: A condition exists; the specific meaning depends on the SPN and OEM implementation.
